items.title: Buddy Collette interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: well I’d be playing a little riff on clarinet and he would pick that up playing it on cello

ctx.x: But you’re right, as long as he — well I’d be playing a little riff on clarinet and he would pick that up playing it on cello, while some of those things, with good sound [scats] he’d make it on the cello see? And it was a sound that not too many people had heard at that point, the cello doing the jazz figures.
Chico decided to go to New York after that?
